sections.st: What is Blister Packaging? — Types, Materials and Applications
leads: Blister packaging is a pre-formed plastic packaging format — a thermoformed plastic cavity sealed with a lidding material (aluminium foil, Tyvek, or film). The cavity holds the product; the lidding seals it and protects against contamination, moisture, and physical damage. It is the dominant primary packaging format for pharmaceutical oral solid dose products globally, and is widely used for medical device packaging components and commercial retail packaging.

Trizen Packaging is a blister packaging manufacturer in India producing PVC pharmaceutical blister packs, PVDC high-barrier blister, Alu-Alu cold form blister, APET and PETG retail blister, Tyvek-compatible thermoformed blister components, child-resistant blister, and tamper-evident blister packs — all from custom in-house CNC tooling at our GMP validated, Cleanroom Class 8 facility in Vapi, Gujarat.

As a blister packaging manufacturer in India, we manufacture the thermoformed blister cavity and, where specified, the lidded blister component — using ETO and Gamma compatible materials (PP, PETG, APET) where medical device applications require it. Device loading and sterilization are performed by the device manufacturer in their own facility.

sections.st: How Blister Packaging is Produced — The Manufacturing Process

rows: Thermoplastic sheet heated and thermoformed against the cavity mould — producing the product cavity. Cavity dimensions, depth, and sealing flange geometry confirmed against specification.
Cavity flange flatness ±0.3mm — critical for foil or Tyvek sealing integrity. Cavity depth consistency across all positions in the formed sheet.

Aluminium foil, Tyvek, or PVC lid film aligned over the empty blister cavities. Heat and pressure applied to the sealing flange. The blister packaging component is supplied to the buyer empty — product loading is performed by the pharmaceutical or device manufacturer.
Foil sealing: 140–200°C · 2–6 bar · 0.3–1.5 sec dwell. Tyvek sealing parameters confirmed at specification stage.
Seals inspected for completeness, seal width consistency, and absence of pinholes or unsealed areas. Pharmaceutical GMP batches: seal integrity inspection per GMP procedure.
Seal width minimum ≥3mm for pharmaceutical foil seal. Visual inspection per GMP procedure.
Blister sheets scored or perforated for individual strip separation where required for pharmacy dispensing.
Clean separation without compromising cavity or seal integrity.
Dimensional inspection against specification. GMP batch records completed per production run — batch number, material lot, process parameters, in-process QC, and outgoing inspection data.
Complete GMP batch documentation per production run for pharmaceutical and medical device blister components.

faqs.q: What does a blister packaging manufacturer in India produce?

Trizen Packaging manufactures the blister packaging component; product loading and sterilization are performed by the pharmaceutical or medical device manufacturer in their own facility.

faqs.q: What is the difference between PVC, PVDC, and Alu-Alu blister packaging?
faqs.a: PVC blister: standard pharmaceutical barrier, WVTR 3.0–5.0 g/m²/day, lowest cost — for OSD drugs with low to moderate moisture sensitivity. PVDC blister: better moisture barrier, WVTR 0.5–2.0 g/m²/day — for moisture-sensitive drugs. Alu-Alu cold form blister (OPA/Alu/PVC composite): maximum moisture barrier, WVTR <0.1 g/m²/day, opaque, premium cost — for highly hygroscopic and specialty pharmaceutical products. Material selection is based on drug product stability data.

faqs.q: Do you manufacture blister packaging components for medical devices?
faqs.a: Yes. Trizen Packaging manufactures thermoformed PETG and APET blister tray components and Tyvek-sealed blister components in ETO and Gamma compatible materials, produced in our Cleanroom Class 8 facility. The blister packaging component is manufactured at Vapi and supplied to the device manufacturer empty. Device loading and sterilization are the device manufacturer's process — Trizen Packaging does not provide device loading or sterilization services.

faqs.q: Is your blister packaging manufacturing GMP compliant?
faqs.a: Yes. Trizen Packaging holds three certifications: GMP validation, ISO 9001:2015, and Cleanroom Class 8 classification — all at our Vapi facility. Full GMP batch documentation — batch records, material COAs, in-process QC, and outgoing inspection — is provided per production batch for pharmaceutical and medical device blister components.
